utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, Gus — have you gotten any timing or tool updates yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the timing and tool list. If you hear anything, send it my way and I’ll bring whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about timing or tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — if I hear of any new trouble spots, I’ll pass them along right away. Sunday at the community center is going to be busy!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — really appreciate it. That’ll help us stay on top of the busy list for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ear out and let you know if any new trouble spots pop up before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I can handle sorting what’s on the table first, and I’ll let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the supply list handy and check back with you after you sort it. Just let me know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll sort through it now and flag anything that’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to confirm the timing and who’s bringing the tools before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll bring whatever I can find to the repair drive table, and I can help confirm the timing too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — can you tell me what time you’re aiming for, and whether anyone else is covering the tools? Once I have that, I can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what part of the repair drive still needs hands? I can sort the donated tools first, then head over to the porch repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We moved it to Sunday at the community center, so start with the donated tools there and then help with the repairs if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll start with the donated tools at the community center, then swing by the repairs if I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school schedule—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy, but I can bring the flashlight and gloves by the repair drive table soon. Just let me know the time and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — I’ll aim for after school, around 3:30, and I’ll confirm the exact time once I check the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive needing from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just point out the broken spots, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the confirmed details, so once you have the start time, I can double-check the rest before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the start time and pass it along once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Once you have the confirmed start time, send it over and I’ll check the rest before we share it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m happy to bring the spare tools by the repair drive spot. I’ll head over there now and see what’s needed first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Let’s start with the porch repairs and quick fixes when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’m on my way to the repair drive spot now, and I’ll start with the porch repairs and quick fixes when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what kind of repairs are needed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — let’s start with the porch repairs first, and I’ll spread the word as soon as I have the plan and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — porch repairs first works for me. Let me know the plan and timing when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m spreading the word that the repair drive starts this weekend, and I’ll repeat the details again tomorrow so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. If you can, please mention that we still need hands for the porch repairs after the tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll mention we still need hands for the porch repairs after the tool sorting, and I’ll repeat it again tomorrow too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the latest details; what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—are we definitely doing the repair drive this week? I’d like to confirm the timing and tool list before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so, but I haven’t seen the latest confirmation either. I can ask around and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still tracking tools, tape, screws, and flashlights for the repair drive. If you’ve got the time, send it over and I’ll keep updating the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a little time, and I can help with the list. Just tell me the first repair Pia wants to start with, and I’ll keep an eye out for the timing and drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll check with Pia on the first repair and get back to you with the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll bring whatever I can find to the repair drive table. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly tools and small parts would help — screws, tape, and anything fix-it related. If you’ve got extras, just bring them by the table.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll gather any screws, tape, and other fix-it bits I can find and bring them by the table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I could use help sorting donations and keeping the repair drive table steady for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — I can help sort the donations and keep the table steady. We’ll meet Sunday at the community center, and I’ll be there to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — that helps a lot. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn—please send me the donation time and whether they want a sign-in list when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll check the donation time and whether they want a sign-in list, then I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still in, but I need the timing and exact drop-off spot first, plus who’s bringing the tools, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the start time, drop-off spot, and who’s bringing the tools, then I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d help a lot—once you have it, send it over and I’ll plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — if you hear what they still need for the repair drive, let me know and I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep listening for what they still need and pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy, but I can bring screws, duct tape, gloves, or a flashlight by the table soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — and just so you know, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center now. Your tools will be handy there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for the heads-up — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll bring the flashlight and gloves there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Leo — thank you. Bring the tools and list by when you can, and we’ll get started on the porch repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring the tools and a list by soon. I can start on the porch repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — thanks. Once you’re here, we’ll start on the porch repairs and then move through the quick fixes together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep telling folks the repair drive starts this weekend, and I’ll repeat the details again tomorrow so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll bring the spare tools to the repair drive spot and keep track of who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind everyone again tomorrow about the repair drive start time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Kira — the repair drive still needs hands for porch repairs, and I’ve got Dane sorting the donated tools first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm the day and whether the tool list is set? I’m still not ready to say yes until I know that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can confirm the day and check the tool list for you right now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — just point out the repairs, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll grab the tool box and show you the porch repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus. Point me to the porch repairs and I’ll stick to the plan.
